preferences: Use nbskill MCP tools for normal notebook reads, edits, execution, review, and diagnostics.
Write notebooks as a story: rationale, implementation, visible example, focused test.
Keep cells small, semantic, direct, and readable.
Explain why the code has this shape and cross-reference downstream uses.
Ask only when ambiguity materially changes the patch.
aversions: Generated-file edits without notebook source changes.
Raw notebook JSON edits when an nbskill MCP tool can do the job.
Large cells, missing docs, hidden outputs, broad refactors, noisy explanations, and speculative architecture.
